information.name: revolut-payments-import
information.description: Automatically records incoming Revolut Business bank payments into UCRM via signed webhooks, matching clients by the sender's IBAN.
information.author: Rosen Velikov

configuration.label: Revolut ClientID
configuration.description: The ClientID issued by Revolut after you upload the API certificate.

configuration.label: OAuth redirect URI
configuration.description: Set this to the plugin's Public URL (the public.php link shown above) and register the SAME value with the certificate in Revolut. The authorization code is then captured automatically — no manual copy. Its domain becomes the JWT 'iss'.

configuration.label: Authorization code (manual fallback)
configuration.description: Normally NOT needed — when the redirect URI points to the plugin's public.php, the code is captured and exchanged automatically. Manual fallback only: paste the 'code' from the redirect URL, then Save. Used once, then cleared.

configuration.label: Revolut accounts to import from (optional)
configuration.description: Comma-separated Revolut account id(s). Leave EMPTY to import from ALL accounts. The available accounts with their ids are listed in the plugin log after saving the configuration, and on the plugin's Public URL with ?accounts=1 (UCRM admin login required).

configuration.label: Backfill history from date (optional)
configuration.description: One-time import of past incoming payments starting from this date. Runs on the next scheduled execution (or 'execute manually'), keeps each payment's original date, never duplicates. Clears itself logically once done; change the date to backfill again.

configuration.label: UCRM payment method (name or ID)
configuration.description: Name or ID of the UCRM payment method to use for imported payments, e.g. 'Bank transfer'.
